name: Thousand Bamboo of the Far West

pages.title: Land of Puppets
pages.text: This entry follows region_cards/extreme_west_thousand_bamboo.json, puppet_definitions.json, puppet_parts_catalog.json, and secret_realms.json#thousand_bamboo_puppet_tower. The extreme_west region is available in the current world data, requires Foundation Establishment, and uses extreme_west_anchor for travel.

pages.title: Current Data
pages.text: Thousand Bamboo of the Far West has a 1.0 aura multiplier and the tags extreme_west, thousand_bamboo, puppet, mechanism, ironwood, and puppet_core_blank. Ironwood, puppet spirit cores, and Thousand Bamboo Sect services remain data tags and hooks for future crafting.

pages.title: Mechanism Tower
pages.text: The Thousand Bamboo Mechanism Tower exists as the world-data secret realm thousand_bamboo_puppet_tower under extreme_west_thousand_bamboo. It requires Foundation Establishment, consumes a middle-grade earth spirit stone, and has a 160000-tick cooldown. The Mechanism Market and Tower Humming events are also in the daily event pool.

pages.title: Planned Content
pages.text: Actual puppet entities, GeckoLib animations, the puppet-crafting UI, ironwood resource nodes, puppet spirit-core items, blueprint drops, Thousand Bamboo Sect NPCs, tower structure generation, and reward tables are not yet implemented. The corresponding native route is projected in the FTB Quests chapter 'Tiannan's Seven Sects and the Hundred Crafts'; native progress remains authoritative. This page describes only existing world-data and guide hooks.
